### Combined treatment and follow-up by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Treatment implementation details | Treatment implementation year | Follow-up approach | Follow-up implementation | Follow-up implementation year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal: no definition** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Not implemented | _Not reported_ | 2024 | Close medical supervision when testing is not possible | Targeted implementation; G6PD testing not conducted and follow-up not implemented except for highland populations with G6PD defiency is known to be a problem. | _Not reported_ |
| **G6PD mild to moderate deficient: no definition** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Not implemented | _Not reported_ | 2024 | Close medical supervision when testing is not possible | Targeted implementation; G6PD testing not conducted and follow-up not implemented except for highland populations with G6PD defiency is known to be a problem. | _Not reported_ |
| **G6PD severely deficient: no definition** | No PQ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | Close medical supervision when testing is not possible | Targeted implementation; G6PD testing not conducted and follow-up not implemented except for highland populations with G6PD defiency is known to be a problem. | _Not reported_ |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25mg/kg/day over 14 days (maximum 15 mg) | Implemented | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | Close medical supervision when testing is not possible | Targeted implementation; G6PD testing not conducted and follow-up not implemented except for highland populations with G6PD defiency is known to be a problem. | _Not reported_ |
